positive_terms: Explanation of how consistency of GHG emission reduction targets with GHG inventory boundaries has been ensured
减排目标与盘查边界一致性
Explanation of how consistency of GHG emission reduction targets with GHG inventory boundaries has been ensured。减排目标与盘查边界一致性。以目标对象、目标年、基准年、排放范围和范围2方法区分事实；绝对减排、相对减排和强度目标不可互换。碳信用和移除不能直接替代毛排放减量。
